afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KGJT 041909 AFDGJT Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Grand Junction CO 109 PM MDT Tue Aug 4 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - Near record heat is expected today. Heavy Advisories remain in effect for some desert valley areas through this evening. - Red Flag Warnings are in place today for various areas of western Colorado through 7 PM, and tomorrow for the central Divide from 1 PM

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION... Hot and dry weather is forecast to continue through the weekend due to building high pressure. Stronger afternoon gusts are creating critical fire weather conditions. So, Red Flag Warnings are in effect for today and tomorrow in some areas of western Colorado. Localized critical fire weather conditions are possible elsewhere. Wind gusts are forecast to weaken by the weekend. Wetting
